description: Fork one recorded run onto several models from the same checkpoint — same files, same conversation prefix — and grade each with a command you choose. SPENDS REAL TOKENS and reaches the network: every model named is actually called. Ask before using it.

from.description: Checkpoint seq to fork at, from orca_checkpoints.

run.description: Run id, or "last" for the newest recording. Defaults to "last". Replay traces are skipped when resolving "last", so it means the newest run you actually recorded.

verify.description: Shell command whose exit code is the verdict, e.g. "npm test".

name: orca_compare
